patch_description: This redesign separates the solution into an oracle layer, a pivot-based estimator, a partition optimizer, and an optional direct-balance polishing stage. The estimator uses a query budget reservation policy: when many queries are available, it preserves a small portion for comparisons of actual bag totals after estimated-weight optimization. The pivot pipeline uses cached comparisons, compact array-backed storage, interpolation between ordered pivots, and direct 1-vs-2 difference probes. The partition phase combines LPT construction, deterministic best-improvement moves/swaps, simulated annealing, and actual balance-guided transfers using reserved comparisons.
